items.title: Pushout of a thickening along an affine morphism exists in algebraic spaces

items.difficulty_reason: Lift the etale cover V -> Y through the thickening equivalence to U' -> X' with U = U' x_{X'} X, apply the scheme-level pushout lemma to get V' = V amalga_U U'; repeat on the fibre products to build R' with etale s', t'; show j' = (t',s') is unramified, a monomorphism (thickening argument), and an equivalence relation (composition map by functoriality of pushouts - 'details omitted' routine); set Y' = V'/R' by the Bootstrap presentation theorem; verify O_{Y'} = O_Y x O_X O_{X'} on Y_etale = (Y')_etale by reducing to V'; and conclude the universal property from the scheme pushout plus uniqueness of the factorization.
